title: AI capability
caption: Four Levels of working with AI on one large language model, seen from several angles: the effort each asks you to manage, its productivity increase, how many people work at it, the AI disciplines it adds and where a person sits in its oversight.
description: An interactive timeline of four Levels of working with AI, from chat to the emerging factory, with the effort each asks you to manage, its productivity increase against what studies measured, how many people work at it, the AI disciplines it adds, and where a person sits in the loop.
